title: Community & Outreach
subtitle: Help these ideas reach the people who could use them
heroIntro: Frameworks nobody has heard of don't govern anything. Sharing this work, arguing with it in public, and connecting it to people whose problems it might fit are all genuinely useful — provided it's described accurately, which this guide is mostly about.

getStartedText: Pick a framework you find interesting, read it properly, and say what you think — including where you think it's wrong. Honest engagement travels further than promotion, and it's what this work most needs right now.
